title: Looking deeper into the algal sisters of land plants
content:
by Susana M. Coelho

Zygnematophyceae are the closest algal relatives of land plants, yet their internal diversity has remained poorly sampled. A new study in PLOS Biology reveals deep radiations that reshape how we reconstruct the algal ancestry of plants.
